lead: I help AdTech, MarTech and B2B SaaS teams make better product decisions and turn them into working software, drawing on six years inside a programmatic DOOH business, hands-on AI product building, and independent research into where the market is going.
disclosure: From 2020 to 2026 I worked at Moving Walls, most recently as Senior Executive Product Manager. I take on a small number of advisory and research engagements.

services.title: Product strategy and roadmap advisory
services.body: A second pair of product eyes on where a platform should go next and in what order.
problems: A roadmap driven by the loudest customer rather than evidence
Features shipping late because discovery happened after the build
Teams across regions pulling in different directions
formats: Discovery plan with interview and usability-testing guides
services.grounding: Owned the end-to-end roadmap for an enterprise programmatic DOOH platform at Moving Walls; a discovery practice there cut rework by about 30%.

services.title: AdTech and MarTech product consulting
services.body: Practical help with the mechanics that make advertising platforms hard to build.
problems: Designing order management, auction logic or deal types
Keeping budgets and inventory consistent across PMP, Preferred and open auction
Connecting the platform to CRM and ERP systems
services.grounding: Led a DSP revamp across six modules, and the Salesforce, Zoho Books and NetSuite integrations.

services.title: Enterprise applications and workflow automation
services.body: Connecting the systems a business already runs on, so information flows without manual work.
problems: Teams re-keying data between the platform, the CRM and finance
A CRM rollout that needs requirements, configuration and adoption
A manual reporting cycle that could run on its own
formats: Requirements for a CRM or ERP integration
services.grounding: Led Salesforce, Zoho Books and NetSuite integrations, an organisation-wide Zoho CRM implementation, and built an AI reporting tool that replaced a manual cycle.

services.title: Market research, writing and commentary
services.body: Research briefings, articles and commentary on the companies, data providers and measurement systems that shape AdTech, MarTech and out-of-home.
problems: Choosing a data or measurement partner for a specific question
Understanding a regional market before entering it
Seeing where competitors and partners actually sit in the stack
formats: Written research brief or bylined article, with sources labelled
services.grounding: Twenty papers in 2026, including regional market studies of the US, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Africa and competitive analyses of the global landscape, plus a 36-page digital magazine.

services.title: AI product discovery and build
services.body: Turning an AI idea into a scoped product, and where it helps, into a working one.
problems: An AI idea with no clear user or workflow
Unsure what should be a model and what should be deterministic
Needing a working prototype before committing a team
formats: Working prototype built with Claude Code
Review of where AI belongs in an existing product
services.grounding: Two AI-powered products taken from requirement to live production without an engineering team, one in 15 days.

services.title: Opportunity assessment for new products
services.body: For founders and investors weighing a product idea in advertising technology.
problems: Is there a real gap, or is it already crowded?
Which layer of the stack should a new product own?
What has to be true for an outcome-based model to work?
services.grounding: Research that maps who holds which layer of the OOH stack, and a proposed Outcome Exchange architecture.

audiences: AdTech and MarTech platforms building or rebuilding products
B2B SaaS companies integrating CRM and ERP systems or automating workflows
Media owners and DOOH networks adding programmatic or data capability
Data and measurement companies working out where they fit
Founders and investors looking at advertising technology

process.title: Conversation
process.body: A short call to understand the problem and whether I'm the right person for it.

process.title: Scoping note
process.body: A one-page note covering the question, what I'll deliver and what I need from you.

process.title: The work
process.body: Research, review, workshop or prototype, with check-ins at the points we agree.

process.title: Handover
process.body: Written findings or working software you can keep using, with sources and assumptions stated.
